content.title: Villanova vs Utah State schedule, TV channel for March Madness game
content.text: Updated March 17, 2026, 3:36 p.m. MTVillanova and Utah State play in a March Madness NCAA Tournament men's college basketball game on Friday, March 20.Here's what to know about the time, TV channel, streaming information and announcers for the West Region March Madness first-round game.Villanova is the No. 8 seed in the region.Utah State is the No. 9 seed.The winner of this game will
